description: Quality Analyst Seprod Group of Companies (member of Musson Group) St. Thomas Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 03/11/2026 Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save Please see Job Description below: Objectives and Purpose of the Job: To efficiently and effectively adhere to laboratory procedures and operating standards.To support the required quality and food safety laws, regulations and corporate policies to ensure a representative level sampling is achieved. Evaluate the effectiveness of the cleaning procedures, the appropriate use of cleaning agents and the strength of chemicals used to clean parlours Assist in ensuring the adoption and practice of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Collection and sampling of feed for external testing Conduct laboratory inventory - adequate supplies of chemicals and materials Take appropriate action to ensure that all laboratory instruments and equipment are operating to specifications. Training in Good Manufacturing Practices Minimum one (1) year related working experience, preferably in a manufacturing company Abilities; Skills; Experience; Aptitude and Judgement; Working Conditions: Exposure to Food Safety, Pest Control and Sanitation Systems Disciplined, high attention to detail and ethically sound Safety management The employee needs to be in good physical condition and have excellent vision. Other Personal or General Characteristics: Disciplined, high attention to detail Ability to work under pressure and to meet deadlines Possess good communication and interpersonal skills Good command of English language, reading, writing and speaking Aptitude for continuous learning, Team Building & motivation.
